description: GIMIN non-leaky 29-feature schema for Paper 2 Workstream 1 ablation. Drops 4 staging-algorithm features (NP3TOT, NHY, PUTAMEN_L_SBR, PUTAMEN_R_SBR) from the original 33-feature schema to eliminate label leakage into the downstream NSD-ISS stage prediction experiment.
rationale: NSD-ISS stage labels in Russo 2025 / Simuni 2024 are derived from MDS-UPDRS Part III (including NP3TOT and implicitly NHY staging threshold), and DaT-SPECT putaminal SBR (PUTAMEN_{L,R}_SBR). Including these four features in the imputation inputs creates a feed-forward path from stage label to imputation decoder, inflating downstream utility gains. This config removes them.
